title: Sega Internet-Selain
overview:
Sega Internet-Selain is the Finnish-language edition of the Sega Saturn web browser for the NetLink Internet Modem. With the modem in the Saturn's cartridge slot and connected to a phone line, insert this disc to browse the World Wide Web and use email on your TV, with menus and text in Finnish.

The browser smooths text for easy reading on a television screen. Navigate with the control pad, or connect a keyboard and mouse for easier typing and pointing.
